findings.description: No omissions: all 34 main-list, 5 joint-list and 15 emeriti-list entries matched brief.people by name, and every brief.people entry appears on exactly one list.

Martin A. Schmidt (RPI President) appears on the main ECSE list and his profile lists ECSE under Other affiliations only. No professorial appointment; excluded as affiliate. Evidence: src_faculty_list, src_schmidt_profile.

Bulent Yener: included as courtesy (current). Official faculty.rpi.edu bio says Professor in Computer Science with a courtesy appointment in ECSE. The joint-appointment page lists him without subtype; the explicit courtesy wording controls. Evidence: src_joint_list, src_yener_profile.

Paul Schoch conflict: the official ECSE emeriti page lists him as emeritus, while his faculty.rpi.edu profile and the emeriti page entry show generic title Associate Professor and Director, CIPCE with no emeritus wording. Resolved as excluded emeritus (past) because a specific official appointment type disambiguates a generic title under source_precedence. The profile is not contradicted by any dated statement, so this should be confirmed by a human reviewer before public counting; if the profile were preferred he would be regular, included, current.

Professor of Practice titles (Celik, Kanai, Neti) were mapped to category academic_professional; Lecturer and Senior Lecturer titles were mapped to teaching. Both are excluded, so the decision is unaffected by the choice between the two policy wordings.

Retrieval: the three required list pages and three supporting profile pages downloaded with HTTP 200. Four optional joint-appointment profiles (Ivanov, Magdon-Ismail, Mishra, Ge Wang) also downloaded with HTTP 200; none contains explicit courtesy wording, so their category is joint_secondary. No 403 or unavailable responses occurred. Profiles for other people were not fetched; list titles were sufficient for those decisions.

No incoming or announced-start appointments were visible on the three list pages or the fetched profiles, so no effective dates were recorded (effective_from_json "null") and no incoming subtotal applies.
